added_lines: safeguarding sunday 22nd february 2026 training a special word of thanks to our diocesan safeguarding trainers, trish o’neill & ailish higgins who facilitated 10 training events in 2025. a total number of 177 church personnel, including clergy, religious, staff and volunteers trained in 2025. the diocesan safeguarding committee joined the ossory safeguarding committee and attended training facilitated by the national board in kilkenny 17th november 2025. the training focused on the role of safeguarding committees in the context of our national church policy and standards for safeguarding children. clonaslee

kildare and leighlin dioceseand and parish safeguarding audits annual safeguarding audit forms were circulated to all parishes on 8th january 2026. to be completed and returned to bishop’s house by 12th march 2026 . the final report for 2024’s audit is available on the diocesan website:

following the 2024 launch of the church’s child safeguarding policy, ailish higgins, our diocesan director of safeguarding met with young people from the diocese to ask them “what does a safe & welcoming church mean to you?” thanks to all the children and young people who took part in these sessions and were open and honest about their experience of parish life. thanks too to their parents, the group leaders and parish priests who supported the facilitation of these groups. national board for safeguarding children in the catholic church in ireland – biannual conference the held their biannual conference from 3rd – 5th september 2025 titled: towards a restorative and transitional justice model of engaging with victims and survivors in the catholic church in ireland. the event aimed to enhance the understanding we all have of how we must engage in a just and restorative way with those who have suffered harm in the catholic church in ireland. our diocesan director of safeguarding and dlp attended the event and shared valuable feedback with our diocesan safeguarding committee. the learning from the conference will help guide our practice going forward. special thanks to the national board for organising and hosting the event. youth participation amadeus christmas clane confirmation class safeguarding checklist for parishes displayed in all church porches the kildare &
